name: Tilo
title: Master Artisan
examine: Sawdust on his cuffs, chalk on his fingers, a measuring string around his neck tied in a knot only he can undo.
lines: Measure twice. Then once more, for the pleasure of it.
My sister Merra says I never finish anything. I'm three years into a chair that will prove her wrong.
The hall's benches are for everyone — the town that makes things together mends together.
